notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill gives OpenTelemetry Collector configuration, Kubernetes Deployment/Service manifests, Python and Node.js SDK setup, Operator auto-instrumentation and tail-sampling configuration.

The skill produces configuration and code for the user rather than telling the agent to run commands; the only command is a commented `helm install` for the OTel Operator inside a YAML example (SKILL.md:349-351). No credentials are used and no data is sent anywhere by the agent.

The sample collector exporters set `tls: insecure: true` for in-cluster endpoints (SKILL.md:117-130) and the SDK samples use insecure=True; users should enable TLS for anything leaving the cluster. Related Skills (SKILL.md:472-476) link to sibling skills ../prometheus-grafana/, ../datadog/, ../alerting-oncall/, ../../ai/rag-observability-evals/, ../../ai/agent-observability/ as optional further reading; they will not ship with this skill.
